name: Anika Sharma
household: Lives alone, frequent Airbnb guests (often friends visiting from out of town)
psychographics: Strives for minimalism and ethical consumption; often feels guilty about convenience spending but justifies it as 'necessary stress relief'.
current_solutions: Uses Olio to share surplus food with neighbours. Relies heavily on supermarket meal deals (e.g., meal deal meal deal) and cooks in bulk on Sundays using a cheap air fryer.
frustration: Attempted to book a last-minute grocery slot on Ocado at 11:30 PM; the system crashed and displayed 'Error 404' for 20 minutes. She ended up ordering a costly Uber Eats meal just to eat something before bed.
decision_style: Compares price per unit obsessively. Often chooses the cheaper option even if it means more prep time, justifying it as 'being smart with money'.
voice: Rambling and self-deprecating, frequently apologizing. Uses British slang like 'cheeky' and 'sorted', but switches to formal language when discussing budgets or ethics.
